name: reserved-field-spoof
description: Reserved envelope fields are stamped AFTER caller fields, so a payload cannot forge system metadata. This is the log-spoofing fix from 0.2.0 and must never regress. NOTE: `level` is deliberately absent from this payload — it is a documented caller input, not a library-owned field, so setting it is legitimate rather than spoofing. `level_code` IS library-owned: it is always derived from the resolved level and can never be set by the caller.
